set.n: A doctor's buried bottles of money in a back yard on old Third Street, Milwaukee (1902)
set.pl: 541 Third St (old numbering): W side of Third St (now N. Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Dr.) just south of Walnut St (1894 Sanborn vol. 1 sheet 64)
pinev: Lot-level: the 1902 address, 541 Third St in the old numbering, falls on the W side of Third St just south of Walnut St on the 1894 Sanborn vol. 1 sheet 64 (about 100 m).
set.st: From Aug 1902 the owner of a house on old Third Street kept finding bottles of coins and paper money buried in the back yard by a doctor who had lived there; nearly $2,000 plus a decayed government bond by mid-October (later wire reports said $7,000, with charts suggesting about $10,000 buried in all). The yard was dug over except a small area. Now built over: look-only. Pin is on the Sanborn lot, not the spot itself.
src: Montreal River Miner and Iron County Republican 22 Oct 1902
